name: open-xlsx-editor
description: Open and edit .xlsx files in the browser. 100% JavaScript, no server, no Office.
author: open-xlsx-editor contributors

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node test/e2e.mjs && node test/editing.mjs && node test/editing-data.mjs && node test/editing-more.mjs && node test/editing-protect.mjs && node test/editing-links.mjs && node test/editing-formats.mjs && node test/editing-borders.mjs && node test/editing-rich.mjs && node test/editing-chartdata.mjs && node test/editing-charts.mjs && node test/a11y.mjs && node test/collab.mjs && node test/pdf.mjs && node test/omf.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src test tools bin && node tools/scan-bytes.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run fixtures && git diff --exit-code test/fixtures && npm run test:e2e && node tools/check-ooxml.mjs test/fixtures test/out
